facts.text: Set within the Beaux Arts Maison Blanche building, which was originally home to the Maison Blanche Department Store.

facts.text: The hotel is at 921 Canal Street, on the edge of the French Quarter, a block from Bourbon Street and Saenger Theatre.
facts.excerpt: Our luxury hotel in New Orleans is located on the edge of the French Quarter. We offer a desirable address just a block from Bourbon Street and Saenger Theatre

facts.text: The Residence is a two-bedroom penthouse suite with a dining room and fully equipped kitchen, four fireplaces and a private rooftop terrace with views of the French Quarter.
facts.excerpt: an elegant dining room with a fully equipped kitchen, four grand fireplaces, and a private rooftop terrace offering breathtaking views of the French Quarter.

facts.text: The Ritz-Carlton Spa covers 25,000 square feet and has 20 treatment rooms, a café and a boutique.
facts.excerpt: Spread across 25,000 square feet, our hotel's spa is the largest in New Orleans and is appointed with 20 treatment rooms, a café and a boutique.

facts.text: Signature spa treatments include a New Orleans-inspired Voodoo Ritual and a couples experience in a specially designed Couples Suite.
facts.excerpt: Signature treatments at our hotel day spa include a New Orleans-inspired Voodoo Ritual and an indulgent couple’s experience in a specially designed Couples Suite.

facts.text: M Bistro serves farm-to-table Louisiana cuisine, and Davenport Lounge offers cocktails and light fare with live jazz.
facts.excerpt: Savor farm-to-table Louisiana cuisine at M Bistro, then indulge in cocktails and light fare accompanied by live jazz at Davenport Lounge.

facts.text: Jeremy Davenport and his band play live jazz at Davenport Lounge.
facts.excerpt: Experience the melodic jazz of Jeremy Davenport and his band Wednesday-Thursday

facts.text: Afternoon tea is served at Davenport Lounge on Saturdays and Sundays, and reservations are required.
facts.excerpt: offered every Saturday and Sunday at 11:00 AM and 2:30 PM. Enjoy a refined selection of teas and pastries in an elegant setting. Reservations are required

facts.text: Club Level guests enjoy five daily culinary presentations, from breakfast to desserts, inspired by Louisiana specialties and plant-based cuisine.
facts.excerpt: Club Level guests enjoy five daily culinary presentations from breakfast to desserts, featuring fresh, sustainably sourced ingredients inspired by Louisiana specialties and plant-based cuisine.

facts.text: Guest rooms feature commissioned artwork inspired by the city's heritage.
facts.excerpt: feature commissioned artwork inspired by the city's heritage, smart TVs with streaming apps, and spacious layouts with executive work desks.
